name: Bastion
description: Bastion was an ancient refueling tanker Wraith Squadron captured on Halmad during a mission disguised as the Hawk-bat Independent Space Force. Wraith pilot Kell Tainer rigged the tanker to blow upon a signal from him, which the Wraiths planned to use in demolishing a newly constructed starfighter base near the city of Hullis on Halmad.
